system_name: ORCHESTER Demo 3 - recycled NdFeB small magnets via H2 decrepitation
description: Magnet-to-magnet recycling route: hydrogen decrepitation of end-of-life magnets, jet milling, pressing and alignment, sintering and annealing, grinding and wire EDM into small magnets.
functional_unit: 1 kg of ground recycled NdFeB small magnets (Kleinmagnete, geschliffen)
